Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some concerns that have been brought to our attention regarding your recent behavior in the workplace. It has come to our attention that there have been multiple complaints about your conduct, which does not align with our company’s values.

We value a respectful and professional work environment for everyone, and we expect all team members to adhere to our professional standards. We believe in addressing issues promptly and constructively, and we are confident that you can make the necessary adjustments to ensure a positive and collaborative workplace.

Please take this opportunity to reflect on the feedback and make immediate improvements in your behavior. If you have any questions or need support in addressing these concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to me or HR.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
